---
title: "Firm-Level Local Projections"
execute:
  cache: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| cache: false
#| include: false

rm(list = ls())
gc()

pacman::p_load(
  targets,
  tidyverse,
  fixest,
  tinytable,
  here
)

here::i_am("notebooks/lp_firms.qmd")
tar_config_set(store = here("_targets"))

source(here("R/lp_firms.R"))
source(here("R/local_projections.R"))

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 13))

# Load targets
lp_firm_cumulative <- tar_read(lp_firm_cumulative)
lp_firm_plots      <- tar_read(lp_firm_plots)
lp_firm_models     <- tar_read(lp_firm_models)

# Outcome display labels (shared across CIT/PIT)
outcome_labels <- c(
  income_tax          = "Income Tax Payable",
  income_taxes        = "Income Taxes",
  social_expenditure  = "Social Exp.",
  revenues            = "Revenue",
  employees           = "Employment",
  investments         = "Investment",
  net_profit          = "Net Profit",
  total_assets        = "Total Assets",
  profit_per_employee = "Profit/Employee"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
#| cache: false

build_firm_summary_table <- function(tx_id, outcome_labels, lp_firm_cumulative, lp_firm_models) {
  block_ids <- paste0(tx_id, "_", names(outcome_labels))

  # h=5 cumulative effects for EAP
  cum <- bind_rows(lp_firm_cumulative[block_ids], .id = "block") |>
    filter(horizon == 5, group == "EAP") |>
    mutate(across(c(coef, se), ~ .x * 100))

  coef_row <- cum$coef |> sprintf(fmt = "%.3f")
  se_row   <- cum$se   |> sprintf(fmt = "(%.3f)")

  # Fit stats from H5 models
  n_row   <- sapply(block_ids, \(b) fitstat(lp_firm_models[[b]]$H5, ~n)[[1]])
  wr2_row <- sapply(block_ids, \(b) r2(lp_firm_models[[b]]$H5, "wr2")) |>
    sprintf(fmt = "%.3f")

  tbl_df <- data.frame(
    ` ` = c("Coef (pp)", "", "N", "Within R\u00b2"),
    rbind(coef_row, se_row, n_row, wr2_row),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(tbl_df) <- c(" ", unname(outcome_labels))

  tt(tbl_df) |>
    style_tt(i = 2, line = "b", line_color = "#d3d3d3")
}
```
